name: Abernathy HPC campus (TeraWulf and Fluidstack joint venture)
summary: AI data center campus in Abernathy, Texas, developed by a joint venture of TeraWulf and Fluidstack announced in October 2025. It is designed for 168 MW of critical IT load (up to 240 MW gross) and is fully pre-leased to a Fluidstack entity for up to 25 years, with Google backstopping about $1.3 billion of the lease obligations; the end user is described only as a global hyperscale AI platform. Project financing was priced in December 2025 and commissioning was targeted for the second half of 2026. In July 2026 TeraWulf agreed to sell its 50.1% stake to a Fluidstack-led investor group, with Fluidstack to keep leading the project.

location.note: Town coordinates from Wikipedia; the sources name Abernathy but give no address. The town spans Hale and Lubbock counties, so no county is recorded.
